name: WebChannelConfig
description:
WebChannelConfig is a web channel's settings: who may chat over its
 hosted link, which sites may embed it, and what visitors see when a
 limit refuses them.

fields.name: Audience
fields.description:
Who can chat over this channel's link. Unspecified means the
 organization's members: a link reaches anyone on the internet only
 when audience is set to public. The server writes an omitted audience
 out as org on create, update and apply, so every stored channel and
 every echo says what it means.

 Update and apply replace the spec wholesale, so a manifest that omits
 audience makes the link organization-only, never public.

fields.name: AllowedOrigins
fields.description:
Origins permitted to embed this channel's chat widget.

 Each entry is an exact web origin (scheme://host[:port]) with no path,
 for example "https://docs.example.com". An empty list allows embedding
 from any site; listing origins restricts embedding to those sites. The
 first-party hosted chat page is always exempt.

fields.name: Messages
fields.description:
Owner-customizable copy shown to visitors when a limit refuses their
 message. Unset fields fall back to platform defaults.
